about: Modern Mining Technology Corp. engages in the recovery and refining of precious and critical metals from electronic waste. The company processes discarded printed circuit boards, old phones, and AI chips to extract metals, including gold, silver, palladium, and copper. It operates a pre-concentration plant that separates metals from plastics and epoxy resins using water-based methods to produce metallic sands concentrate. The company also operates an aqueous purification plant that refines metallic sands concentrate through hydrometallurgical techniques to isolate and purify individual metals for sale into industrial supply chains and commodity markets. In addition, it sells metallic sands concentrate as a partially refined intermediate product to downstream metal recyclers. The company was formerly known as 1285896 B.C. Ltd and changed its name to Modern Mining Technology Corp. in August 2021. Modern Mining Technology Corp. was incorporated in 2021 and is based in Vancouver, Canada.
